parsed.answer: Our delivery policy doesn't include a maximum parcel weight, so I can't give you a limit. For weight restrictions, please check Northwind Parcel's shipping guidelines or contact our support team directly. I can still help with your shipments NW1001, NW1002, NW1003 or NW1004, or with the prohibited items rules if you're unsure whether something can be sent.
